gitLane.note: Anonymous git read works. Git LFS objects are NOT served on this lane, so a repository that stores weights in LFS yields pointer stubs, not weights.
gitLane.lfsNote: Git LFS objects are not served on the anonymous lane, so any repository storing weights in LFS yields pointer stubs. That rules out the usual way a model reaches GitHub.

githubHttpLane.consequence: GitHub release assets are not an available channel: the git lane is served and the HTTP download lane is not.
